import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    S = int(data[2]) - 1
    T = int(data[3])

    # First while loop: reduce T until it is a multiple of N
    while T % N != 0:
        if S < M:
            S = (S + T) % N
        else:
            S = (S - T) % N
        T -= 1

    T //= N  # integer division (like Java long division truncates)

    last = [-1] * N
    cur = 0
    last[S] = cur

    while T > 0:
        T -= 1  # matches Java's T-- (decrement after check)
        for i in range(N - 1, 0, -1):  # i from N-1 down to 1
            if S < M:
                S = (S + i) % N
            else:
                S = (S - i) % N
        cur += 1
        if last[S] != -1:
            T = T % (cur - last[S])
        last[S] = cur

    print(S + 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
